rationale: Comment-hygiene kill-fixture read via fs at test runtime, never imported: comment-fixtures.test.ts does readFileSync(FIXTURES/offenders.ts) and runs the shipped extractor + classifier over its source text, so it is unreachable in knip's import graph by construction. It holds comments copied verbatim from the tree that the policy MUST reject, so a green run proves the detector fires on real prose rather than on invented strings. Same class as the architecture/__fixtures__ rows below, and deliberately NOT promoted to a knip `entry` or added to `ignore`: both change what the graph treats as reachable, and the fixture's value is that its contents are DATA the detector reads, not code anything calls. Retire when the fixture corpus is deleted or the classifier stops reading it by path.

Ambient module declaration for `bun`, consumed by the TypeScript COMPILER rather than by an import edge, so it is unreachable in knip's graph by construction. It became visible only when task 066 added `tsconfig.scripts.json` and put `scripts/**/*.ts` under a typecheck for the first time - scripts/build-binary.ts imports 'bun', and without this shim that file does not compile. Precedent: servers/exarchos-mcp/src/storage/__shims__/bun-sqlite.d.ts, and 066 followed its stated reason for staying narrower than @types/bun. Deliberately an allowlist row, not a knip `entry` or `ignore`: both alter what the graph treats as reachable, and a .d.ts has no runtime existence to make reachable. Retire when scripts/build-binary.ts stops importing 'bun' or @types/bun is adopted.

DR-1 kill-probe corpus fixture read via fs at test runtime (not imported): layer-boundaries-seam.test.ts:492 does readFile(VIOLATOR_FIXTURE) and runs the SHIPPED detector over its source text. Same class as swallows.fixture.ts above. Deliberately NOT promoted to a knip `entry` and NOT added to `ignore`: both change what knip's graph considers reachable, and this fixture imports EVENT_EMISSION_REGISTRY precisely because it is the seam BYPASS being falsified - laundering that import into a live use would weaken the very census the fixture exists to fail. An allowlist row exempts the finding without touching the graph.
